name: Generic Project
description: For any work without a specialized template: state a goal and requirements, pick reference files, and say what you want delivered.
metadataOnlyNote: Template metadata only: this version records inputs and planned outputs. Workflows and agents that produce the outputs arrive in later milestones (M3/M4).

inputFields.label: Goal
inputFields.help: What this project should achieve, in a sentence or two.

inputFields.label: Requirements
inputFields.help: Must-haves, constraints and anything the result has to satisfy.

inputFields.label: Reference files
inputFields.help: Files the project may read. Only files you select are used.

inputFields.label: Expected deliverable
inputFields.help: The text or Markdown document you want at the end.

artifactTypes.name: Requested draft
artifactTypes.description: The requested text or Markdown deliverable, as a draft for your review.

offlineLimitations: Uses only the reference files you select. It does no web lookups.
Drafting needs an available AI model. Offline, that means a local model.
